rawContent: Black folks: be on your guard, keep your head on a swivel and watch out for retribution. Stick together. Hold each other close. These pigs will be out for blood and we'll be at the top of the hit list. If you can, stay home and lay low. #BlackLivesMatter
Say that baby's name: MA'KIYAH BRYANT. #SayHerName #MakiahBryant #ACAB #AbolishThePolice #BlackLivesMatter

That Ma'Khia didn't even have a chance to attain womanhood and was still disrespected and neglected at such a young, tender age, fills me with a grief that I don't think I'll climb out of anytime soon. #JusticeForMakhiaBryant #ACAB #AbolishThePolice #BlackLivesMatter
